title: The Qur'an & You
excerpt: Looking at the beginning of Surah al-Baqarah, you will notice that the very first characteristic of the Muttaqin, Allah lists is that they believe in al-Ghayb - the unseen world. Besides the obvious, there are a few practical implications of this concept in your life.  Mainly because you - O Muwahhid [person of Tawhid [monotheism] - believe what you believe not because it is popular, easy, cute and cuddly, or will get you more visits to your website.
